title: Multiwythe walls with airspace.
officialText:
Where a continuous airspace separates multiple wythes of the wall or partition, the total fire-resistance rating shall be determined by the formula: R = (R + R 0.59+ ...+R 0.59+ as)1.7 (Equation 7-10) 10.59 2 n where: R = The fire endurance of the assembly (hours).

R , R and R = The fire endurance of the individual wythes (hours). 1 2 n

as = Coefficient for continuous airspace. Values for R 0.59 for use in Equation 7-10 are given in Table 721.4.1(3). The coefficient for each continuous n airspace of 1/ inch to 31/ inches (12.7 to 89 mm) separating two individual wythes shall be 0.3. 2 2
